tbesh_html:
1) to go out, be extinguished, dry up
1a) (Qal) to go out, be extinguished
1b) (Niphal) to be made extinct, be dried up
1c) (Pual) to be extinguished, be quenched

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to be extinguished; figuratively, to expire or be dried up
strongs_1890.kjv_def: be extinct, consumed, put out, quenched.
